sheet.bellevue: How much does carpet installation cost in Bellevue, WA?

Carpet installation in Bellevue costs about $4 to $7 per square foot installed, counting carpet, pad, labor, tack strip and haul-away. A typical Bellevue project runs $2,000 to $4,500, and a 1,200 sq ft main floor with a staircase usually lands between $5,500 and $8,500. Carpet grade is the biggest single factor — and you pick it yourself from the samples we bring to your home.
Do you have a mobile carpet showroom in Bellevue?

Yes. Our mobile carpet showroom comes to your Bellevue home with 20+ carpet samples and all three pad grades. We lay the samples on the floor they are going on so you see the color in your own light, then measure every room and stair and leave a written price the same visit. No store to drive to, and the visit is free.
How much does carpet stretching cost in Bellevue?

Carpet stretching in Bellevue starts at $99 per room. Power-stretching pulls out ripples, waves and trip hazards for roughly a fifth of the cost of replacing the carpet, so it is the right call whenever the pile is still standing and you still like the color.
How much does it cost to carpet stairs in Bellevue?
Stair carpet installation starts at $18 per step, in waterfall or cap-and-band style. Landings and pie-shaped turns are counted in the written quote up front rather than billed as an extra later.
How long does carpet installation take?

Most Bellevue homes are carpeted in a single day. Three or four rooms plus a staircase is a comfortable day for our crew; a whole house with stairs and a lot of furniture can run into a second day. The schedule is written on your quote.
Do carpet installers move the furniture?

Yes. Beds, dressers, couches and tables are included on most jobs and we put everything back where it was. We ask you to clear the small items: closets, electronics, breakables and anything you would rather pack yourself.
Should I stretch my carpet or replace it?

Stretch it if the pile is still standing, the backing is intact and you still like the color — that is a $99-per-room fix instead of a replacement. Replace it if traffic paths are matted flat, seams are splitting, the backing is delaminating, or pet odor survived professional cleaning. We tell you which one you have before we quote.
Which Bellevue neighborhoods do you serve?

We carpet homes across all of Bellevue — West Bellevue, Downtown, Crossroads, Lake Hills, Factoria, Somerset, Newport Hills, Eastgate, Wilburton, Bridle Trails, Northwest Bellevue, Woodridge, Cougar Mountain and Clyde Hill — plus the wider Eastside and Seattle.
What carpet is best for pets?

Solution-dyed nylon with a sealed backing over a moisture-barrier pad is the best carpet for pets. The sealed backing and barrier pad stop accidents from reaching the subfloor, which is what causes lasting odor, and the fiber can be cleaned with diluted bleach without losing color. The pad upgrade starts at $0.65 per square foot.
What warranty comes with carpet installation?

You get a 1-year workmanship warranty from OC Flooring on the installation, plus the mill warranty on the carpet itself — usually 10 to 25 years on wear and stain depending on grade. Both are written on your quote, and the pad grade you choose can affect the mill warranty, which is why we bring all three grades to the visit.
